medicines.name: Dolo 650 Tablet
medicines.description: Dolo 650 Tablet is an antipyretic medicine used to relieve fever and mild to moderate pain including headache, body ache, and toothache.
medicines.uses: Fever reduction, headache relief, muscle soreness, post-vaccination fever
medicines.warnings: Do not exceed 4g paracetamol per day. Avoid alcohol while taking this medication.
medicines.storage_info: Store below 30°C in a dry place away from direct sunlight.

medicines.name: Crocin 500mg Advance
medicines.description: Crocin Advance features Optizorb technology which gets to work 5 times faster than standard paracetamol tablets.
medicines.uses: Fast fever relief, joint pain, dental pain, backache
medicines.warnings: Consult doctor if fever persists for more than 3 days.
medicines.storage_info: Keep out of reach of children. Store in original pack.

medicines.name: Combiflam Tablet
medicines.description: Combiflam combines NSAID ibuprofen with paracetamol for powerful anti-inflammatory and dual action pain relief.
medicines.uses: Severe headache, arthritis pain, dental surgery pain, period pain
medicines.warnings: Take with food or milk to prevent stomach upset. Not recommended in kidney diseases.
medicines.storage_info: Store in a cool dry place.

medicines.name: Becosules Z Capsules
medicines.description: Essential B-complex vitamins enriched with Vitamin C and elemental Zinc to boost immunity, tissue repair and cellular energy.
medicines.uses: Mouth ulcers, general weakness, recovery after illness, hair and skin nutritional support
medicines.warnings: May cause harmless harmless yellow discoloration of urine due to Vitamin B2.
medicines.storage_info: Store in cool place protected from light.

medicines.name: Amoxyclav 625mg Tablet
medicines.description: Broad spectrum penicillin-type antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections of lungs, ears, sinuses, urinary tract and skin.
medicines.uses: Bacterial sinusitis, bronchitis, pneumonia, UTI, wound infection
medicines.warnings: PRESCRIPTION REQUIRED. Complete full course as prescribed even if symptoms improve.
medicines.storage_info: Store away from heat and moisture.

medicines.name: Glycomet 500mg SR
medicines.description: Sustained release oral antihyperglycemic drug for managing Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
medicines.uses: Blood sugar level maintenance, Type 2 diabetes control
medicines.warnings: PRESCRIPTION REQUIRED. Take with evening meal. Monitor kidney function regularly.

medicines.name: Pan-40 Tablet
medicines.description: Proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that reduces acid production in the stomach, curing heart burn and acid reflux.
medicines.uses: GERD, acid reflux, stomach ulcer prevention, acidity
medicines.warnings: Swallow whole with water 30 minutes before breakfast.

medicines.name: Eno Fruit Salt (Lemon Flavour)
medicines.description: Fast acting antacid powder that neutralizes stomach acid in 6 seconds to provide relief from gas and indigestion.
medicines.uses: Acidity, heartburn, gas bloating, heavy stomach after meals
medicines.warnings: Do not take more than 2 sachets in 24 hours.

medicines.name: Limcee 500mg Chewable
medicines.description: Tangy orange chewable tablets supplying daily requirement of Vitamin C to bolster immunity and collagen growth.
medicines.uses: Immunity improvement, cold prevention, antioxidant support
medicines.warnings: Chew tablet before swallowing. Do not overdose.

medicines.name: Betadine 10% Ointment 15g
medicines.description: Topical antiseptic ointment for treatment and prevention of infection in minor cuts, scrapes, burns and abrasions.
medicines.uses: Wound cleaning, burn disinfection, surgical dressing support
medicines.warnings: For external use only. Discontinue if rash occurs.

medicines.name: DermaViva Aloe Vera Gel 100g
medicines.description: Organic aloe vera gel providing intense hydration, soothing sunburns, calming irritated skin and reducing redness.
medicines.uses: Skin hydration, acne soothing, hair styling, post-shave balm
medicines.warnings: Patch test recommended before full application.
medicines.storage_info: Keep in refrigerator for extra cooling effect.

medicines.name: Accu-Chek Active Test Strips 50s
medicines.description: Precision blood glucose testing strips for Accu-Chek Active glucometer with fast 5-second result output.
medicines.uses: Self-monitoring of blood glucose levels at home
medicines.warnings: Use within 3 months of opening container.
medicines.storage_info: Close container lid tightly immediately after removing strip.

medicines.name: Omron M2 Basic Automatic BP Monitor
medicines.description: Fully automatic digital blood pressure monitor with Intellisense technology for accurate and painless inflation.
medicines.uses: Systolic/diastolic blood pressure and pulse rate tracking
medicines.warnings: Rest for 5 minutes before taking reading.

medicines.name: Pampers Premium Care Diapers (M)
medicines.description: Cottonlike softness with 3 3D absorbing channels to keep baby dry up to 12 hours with wetness indicator.
medicines.uses: Infant overnight dryness and rash prevention
medicines.warnings: Change diaper immediately when wetness indicator turns blue.

medicines.name: Sebamed Baby Gentle Wash 200ml
medicines.description: 100% soap-free and alkali-free cleanser with ideal pH 5.5 to support baby skin natural protective acid mantle.
medicines.uses: Daily bath care for newborn delicate sensitive skin
medicines.warnings: Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

medicines.name: Evion 400mg Vitamin E Capsule
medicines.description: Lipid-soluble antioxidant vitamin E nourishing cellular membranes, improving skin glow and muscle healing.
medicines.uses: Skin moisture, anti-aging nourishment, leg cramp prevention
medicines.warnings: Consult physician if taking anticoagulant medications.
medicines.storage_info: Keep bottle tightly closed in dark room.

medicines.name: Revital H Capsule for Men
medicines.description: Daily health supplement with Natural Ginseng to stay active, energetic and overcome daily physical stress.
medicines.uses: Mental stamina, physical endurance, daily energy retention
medicines.warnings: Take 1 capsule daily after breakfast with water.

medicines.name: Dexorange Syrup 200ml
medicines.generic_name: Ferric Ammonium Citrate + Folic Acid + Cyanocobalamin
medicines.description: Delicious iron syrup helping build hemoglobin, red blood cells and treat anemia in women, teenagers and elderly.
medicines.uses: Iron deficiency anemia, pregnancy nutritional support, fatigue
medicines.warnings: May cause dark stools which is normal with oral iron.

medicines.name: Volini Pain Relief Spray 100g
medicines.description: Quick action pain relief aerosol spray providing deep micro-penetration for instant joint and back pain relief.
medicines.uses: Sprains, neck pain, lower back pain, sports injuries
medicines.warnings: Flammable. Do not spray near open flame or eyes.

medicines.name: Otrivin Adult Nasal Spray 10ml
medicines.description: Fast acting decongestant opening blocked nose within 2 minutes and keeping nasal passages clear for up to 12 hours.
medicines.uses: Nasal congestion due to cold, hay fever, sinusitis
medicines.warnings: Do not use continuously for more than 7 consecutive days.
medicines.storage_info: Keep nozzle cap closed after use.
